recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless a later PA decision changes the deceased practitioner modifier policy or the exact rationale.

additional_context: Practitioner is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, so the inspected StructureDefinition is in current build scope. PA 2023-03-29 minutes record FHIR-37897 as Persuasive with a 5-0-0 vote. Searches found no Zulip discussion or additional Confluence full-text evidence that conflicts with the Jira/source conclusion.
